description: This file defines an interface and classes related to detecting emoji variants, including specific logic for person-related emoji variants and skin tone variations.

classes.name: VariantDetector
classes.description: Interface for detecting if one emoji variant is a variant of another.

classes.name: None
classes.description: Implementation of VariantDetector that always returns false, indicating no variants.

classes.name: PersonDetector
classes.description: Implementation of VariantDetector that detects emoji variants based on tags, descriptions, and skin tones, especially for person-related emojis.

methods.name: isVariant
methods.description: Determines if one emoji is a variant of another based on specific criteria.

methods.name: addAllSkinTones
methods.description: Populates a map with skin tone variations for emoji descriptions.
